title: Gulf Place Townhome Pool, Tennis & Beach Access
meta_description: Changes in Latitude: 3BR/2.5BA Gulf Place townhome with pool views, beach access, tennis & pickleball courts, bikes, and coastal décor. Sleeps 10 on 30A.
description_expanded: AboutProperty Highlights: ● Fully remodeled kitchen, bathrooms, and new furniture ● Overlooks one of three large community pools, hot tubs ● Steps from three beach access points, including ADA-accessible Ed Walline Beach ● Tennis court ● Four pickle ball courts ● Nature trail ● Margarita machine ● Three Adult Bikes ● Free entertainment at Gulf Place amphitheater ● Walk to Gulf Place boutique shopping and dining ● Thoughtfully designed coastal décor with open-concept living spaces ● Open-concept living area ● Fully stocked kitchen ● Propane Grill ● Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella ● Free wifi ● Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each Changes in Latitude is a serene retreat located in Gulf Place, offering boutique shopping, delicious dining, and entertainment just steps away. Steps from local 30A favorites like The Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, and nearby ice cream spots. This 30A vacation rental is conveniently located near tennis courts, a tranquil community pool, and the 30A Ed Walline Regional Public Beach Access with ADA accessibility, picnic shelters, and seasonal lifeguards. This spacious 3-bedroom townhome sleeps up to 10 guests, blending classic coastal charm with vibrant 30A living. Thoughtfully designed interiors feature curated coastal décor and an open layout ideal for relaxing or entertaining after sun-filled days. The first floor includes a welcoming living and dining area open to a fully stocked kitchen, perfect for gatherings. A screened porch overlooks the serene community pool, providing a peaceful space to unwind. A bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks and a half bath on this level adds convenience and comfort. The upper level is home to the luxurious primary king suite, complete with a private balcony, ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub and walk-in shower, and tranquil pool views. A second king suite offers an ensuite bathroom and privacy for additional guests. Both levels feature porches overlooking lush parkways with nature trails, greenery, and spaces for outdoor games. That's not all-the new living room couches have a sleeper sofa! Gulf Place amenities include multiple pools, tennis court, four pickle ball courts, and free entertainment at the amphitheater. Walk to boutique shops, dining, and the beach, or relax with the provided beach essentials, including four backpack chairs and an umbrella. Whether you're looking for a peaceful escape or a vibrant 30A adventure, Changes in Latitude delivers the ultimate vacation experience.
